title: Write down how we will build it, before building it
statement: As an architect, I can publish how we will build a feature as a slide deck and an essay before any code exists, so the team can weigh the approach before anyone builds it.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Plan can be created and published, with slides and an essay, in a repository where none of the code it describes exists yet, and nothing asks any of its slides to cite code.
A reader who opens a Plan can tell from that page alone that it describes intended work, not work that has been built.
Publishing a Plan does not change documentation coverage, review coverage, or the implementation or UX coverage of any story.
A Saga with no Plans, and a review with no Plan, validate and report exactly as they did before Plans existed.
